build_res2net_backbone: build a Res2Net backbone from a detectron2 config for object detection feature extraction
build_res2net_fpn_backbone: build a Res2Net backbone with FPN and P6/P7 levels for multi-scale object detection
build_res2net_bifpn_backbone: build a Res2Net backbone with BiFPN for efficient feature pyramid network detection
create_bottleneck_block: create a Res2Net BottleneckBlock with multi-scale representation using configurable scale and basewidth parameters
create_deform_bottleneck_block: create a DeformBottleneckBlock with modulated deformable convolutions for improved spatial feature learning
